steps.description:
- At the other side of the lake, you cannot reach the ledge at the end.
- To get on top of it, **pull the boat** from the water and **step upward** to get on the ledge.
- **Climb on the vine**, and **jump to the hanging chain**.
- **Climb up** to get to the higher slope.

1. Proceed to the forest, but ==do not step on one of two bear traps== ahead, or you will lose your head.
2. **Pull its handle** to give wider space between two deadly traps, and **jump over them** to pass.
3. You will notice a rotten corpse on the rope tied on the cliff branch, but you cannot reach the top cliff when the corpse adds weight to the rope level and branch.
4. To remove it, **use the bear trap** below.
5. **Pull it out** and let it aim under the corpse.
6. **Grab the rope** and the corpse will be obliterated into pieces and lightens the weight.
7. **Get to the top cliff** to go to the next chapter.

callouts.title: Unmarked list line
callouts.text: In the source's Traps and obstacles list, the line "Dead corpse" follows the three bulleted entries without a bullet marker.

callouts.title: Corpse
callouts.text: Source remark, kept as written - corpse: it seems to be not be human, of it having bones stuck through its head and no legs/arms and is dead (obviously).
